title: Pip and the Tapping Tub
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ai, ee, igh

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing beside a large grey rain tub in a garden.
Pip the sparrow sitting very still beside the tub, head tilted, listening to a tapping sound.

pages.text: Pip did not peek in the tub.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow sitting with his eyes closed beside the tub, deliberately not looking inside.

pages.text: Is it Ned? Is it Nell?
pages.illustration: A thought-bubble style view above Pip showing small pictures of Ned the duckling and Nell the bee.

pages.text: Pip did peek. It is Ned!
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking over the rim of the grey tub, spotting Ned the duckling down inside it.

pages.text: Ned taps the tub with his bill.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling down inside the tub, tapping the grey side of it with his beak.

pages.text: Ned did it! Pip did not see it.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking down at Ned inside the tub, both smiling.

pages.text: Pip and Ned sit at the tub. Pip had fun.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling sitting together beside the grey tub.
